description: Read identity, payload-credit measurement and checksum guards, plus an equivalent chunking control.

sabotages.name: NUMA request falls back silently to heap buffers
sabotages.why: Live tests observe allocation backing rather than inferring it from config or node-zero residency on a single-node host.

sabotages.name: generated source uses the wrong logical offset
sabotages.why: Generated input must agree with the reference block identities, not simply checksum whatever bytes arrived.

sabotages.name: missing Windows node labels become zero
sabotages.why: Synthetic selection must preserve missing labels rather than manufacture usable node-zero placements.

sabotages.name: summary merges all ordered-dictionary sweeps
sabotages.why: Replay must retain distinct control envelopes and both overlapping and disjoint points; a property-only grouping ignores dictionary keys.

sabotages.name: block sweep accidentally changes payload allowance
sabotages.why: The executable matrix test checks the fixed byte budget as block size changes, not a copied list of configurations.

sabotages.name: pending reads ignore the independent read limit
sabotages.why: The live matrix holds more buffers than pending reads and checks the actual peak against the read ceiling.

sabotages.name: processor ignores the configured batch quantum
sabotages.why: Prefilled queues must produce the exact nonempty full/partial batches, not just pass checksum validation.

sabotages.name: role reversal never reaches worker bindings
sabotages.why: Both pure mapping and live worker observations must change when the processor orientation changes.

sabotages.name: execution repeats the first schedule row
sabotages.why: The live capture must follow the balanced schedule, not merely test an unused order helper.

sabotages.name: every read targets the first block
sabotages.why: The real asynchronous input is wrong; live per-block reference validation must reject it.
sabotages.find: let offset = id as u64 * self.block_bytes as u64;

sabotages.name: checksum is constant
sabotages.why: Known checksum vectors must reject an algorithm defect even when reference and measured paths share it.

sabotages.name: reported leased buffers exceed configured pool
sabotages.why: Live capture assertions check the measured resource bound, not only config validation.

sabotages.name: equivalent smaller checksum chunks
sabotages.why: Chunk boundaries affect budget-check cadence, not the checksum or the accepted result census.
